base_prompt: Turkish alternative pop, intimate live studio band, instrumental only. Warm acoustic guitar, expressive piano, melodic electric bass, real drum kit, restrained clean electric guitar. Cohesive memorable recurring two-bar lead motif, human microtiming and touch, breathing room for a future singer. No EDM drop, no genre switch, no dense synth layers, no vocals or speech. Key D minor, 102 BPM, 4/4. Lead motif: Syncopated two-bar motif in D minor. Bar 1 begins on the 'and' of beat 1 with an assertive leap from A4 to D5, stepping down across C5, Bb4, and sustaining A4 across beat 4. Bar 2 drops to F4 on beat 2 before resolving down to D4 with an airy vibrato decay over beats 3 and 4..

timeline.name: intro
timeline.arrangement: Sparse fingerpicked steel-string acoustic guitar outlining the primary D minor motif, supported by a warm sub-bass drone and subtle ambient vinyl crackle.

timeline.name: verse_1
timeline.arrangement: Upright muted bass enters with steady root-fifth alternation, accompanied by dry acoustic guitar fingerpicking and soft rim-shots on beats 2 and 4. Vocal remains dry and upfront.

timeline.name: pre_1
timeline.arrangement: Rhodes piano enters with sustained suspended voicings. Bass moves into continuous eighth notes while a closed hi-hat introduces a subtle driving groove.

timeline.name: chorus_1
timeline.arrangement: Full dynamic lift featuring energetic acoustic strumming, live snare backbeat, warm bass guitar, and an electric guitar articulating the signature hook phrase.

timeline.name: turnaround
timeline.arrangement: Quick two-bar dynamic drop. Reverb wash lingers as the acoustic guitar plays a descending scalar cadence into silence.

timeline.name: verse_2
timeline.arrangement: Fingerpicked acoustic returns with added subtle percussion shakers and syncopated electric bass accents highlighting vocal phrasing gaps.

timeline.name: pre_2
timeline.arrangement: Intensified build with rising tom rolls, Rhodes tremolo, and swelling electric guitar swells resolving directly into the chorus downbeat.

timeline.name: chorus_2
timeline.arrangement: Full rhythm section with open hi-hat patterns, doubled acoustic rhythm guitars, and vocal backing harmonies tracking the main hook in thirds.

timeline.name: bridge
timeline.arrangement: Dramatic breakdown to solo Rhodes electric piano and sustained cello pedal tone. Vocals take on a breathy, exposed presence without rhythm section support.

timeline.name: final_chorus
timeline.arrangement: Peak intensity with driving live drum kit, layered vocal unisons, soaring slide guitar countermelody, and rich electric bass foundation.

timeline.name: outro
timeline.arrangement: Arrangement thins to a lone fingerpicked acoustic guitar fading out beneath ambient atmospheric train sounds and a solitary concluding D minor chord.
